Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 545 PM EDT.

and other poor-drainage areas, including farmland, parks,
greenways, boat-access areas, golf courses, underpasses, and
parking lots.  Isolated, shallow flows over roadways is possible.
A few flood-prone, low-water crossings may become impassible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 156 PM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicate
earlier heavy rain across the Goose Creek and Crooked Creek
watersheds has ended.  Light showers persist across the Advisory
area, but these showers will not exacerbate ongoing excessive
runoff and stream rises. However, North Fork Crooked Creek and
South Fork Crooked Creek continue to rise with bankfull
conditions possible over the next 1-2 hours before these streams
crest.  Therefore, the Flood Advisory will remain in effect
through at least 3pm to allow streams to crest and conditions to
improve. Isolated areas of nuisance flooding may be ongoing in
areas from Matthews to Indian Trail to Hemby Bridge, especially
adjacent to the north and south forks of Crooked Creek.

- Additional rounds of showers and thunderstorms are expected to
develop through the early evening in the vicinity of the current
Advisory area.  These showers and storms will be very efficient
at producing brief periods of heavy rainfall. Where earlier heavy
rainfall has occurred, soils are saturated and streams are
elevated.  Therefore, additional heavy rain may quickly create
new areas of flooding and cause previous areas of flooding to
redevelop.  Caution is advised near any stream or other
vulnerable area.  Stay weather aware through this evening and
have multiple ways to receive Advisories and Warnings.

Matthews, Indian Trail, Unionville, and Hemby Bridge.
